title: Sequin See-Through Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shimmer and shine in this dazzling evening dress! Featuring sparkling sequins, elegant tulle ruffle sleeves, and a figure-flattering silhouette, this gown is perfect for making a grand entrance at any formal event or special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
